items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: I played with everyone. Clyde Lucas, Rory Ballet and all the rest of them.

ctx.x: Alright, what about The Strand? I'll bring back an incident. The Strand...

The Strand was a long picture theater. And it had... Most of the time it had Don Filippini as the director. He could get more out of a waltz and most of them could get out of a symphony. Then afterwards it had Castro Carraza who went over to the singer. But he couldn't play Stardust unless he got the record and found out what the tempo was. He didn't know A from a bull's foot but he could stand up there and direct the orchestra. He was stiff as a post. Mr. Barr used to tell him, Castro get down off that sump box.…
I said, we all that shit.
